name: JFE Holdings
business_summary: JFE Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in steel, engineering, and trading businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through the Steel, Engineering, and Trading segments. The Steel segment produces and sells various steel products, processed steel products, and raw materials, as well as transportation, facility maintenance, and construction services. Its Engineering segment is involved in engineering activities for steel structures, industrial machines, energy and environment, recycling, and electricity retailing sectors. The Trading segment purchases, processes, and distributes steel products, raw materials for steelmaking, nonferrous metal, food, and other products. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
